lines.0: Hello Ananya! I’m Asha, your AI teacher. Today we’ll estimate collections, like counting many cooking ingredients. What food do you like making?
lines.1: Maggi sounds tasty! Imagine counting peanuts in a paper cone; would you count every one or make groups? Tell Golu later.
lines.2: Good grouping idea, Ananya. For a quicker estimate, make groups of 10 peanuts. How many groups would make about 40 peanuts?
lines.3: Yes, four groups of 10 make 40. Now look at the marbles: what should we do first?
lines.4: Pehle 10 marbles alag rakho; unka size dekho. Kya bachi heap mein aise lagbhag kitne groups dikhenge?
lines.5: Teen groups plus ek group jaisa, yani lagbhag 40. What do we do next? 40 is ___ to 43, so it was a good estimate.
lines.6: Yes, 40 is close to 43. I am going to spread these 8 bangles out in a long line. Before I do it: will there be more bangles, fewer, or the same?
lines.7: Tumne shape badalne par cheezon ki sankhya par dhyaan diya. Ab card par agla step dekho. I am going to spread these 8 bangles out in a long line. Before I do it
lines.8: Getting stuck is okay; this change in shape can feel tricky. Count the bangles once before moving them. I am going to spread these 8 bangles out in a long line.
lines.9: Spreading them out can look like more, but moving objects does not add any. Remember from last time: what is an estimate?
lines.10: Estimate mein exact count nahi, bas paas-paas ka guess hota hai. Remember from last time: what is an estimate?
lines.11: Yes—an estimate is a close guess without counting each one. If there are 43 marbles, is 40 a close estimate?
lines.12: Tara guessed there were 30 peanuts. When she counted, there were 32. Was her guess a good guess?
lines.13: Yes—your reason was right: 30 is close to 32. Was it good because it was close, or because it matched exactly?
lines.14: Right, Ananya: a good estimate is close, not an exact match. About 10 people can sit on one bench at the railway station. There are 7 benches and all are full.

lines.5: Sahi, doosra term 3 hai. Isliye 6x plus 9x ka factorised form 3x bracket mein 2 plus 3 hoga. Bracket band kijiye.

lines.12: Bilkul: 2 plus 3, 5; 2 times 3, 6. Isliye (x + 2)(x + 3). Ab expand karke middle term check kijiye.
lines.13: Expansion mein har term ka product include karke aapne middle terms combine kiye. 6x + 9 ka factorisation kariye.
